message.content: {"summary":"You submitted a well-argued ethics report featuring strong stakeholder awareness, balanced critical discussion, and solid alignment with professional frameworks. Your arguments effectively justified your final recommendations. To improve future submissions, address key technical and structural oversights: ensure required elements like the abstract and visual aids are included, carefully proofread headings and text, and double-check all arithmetic and external case study facts.","next_steps":["Include an abstract and relevant visual aids (such as tables or diagrams) to meet full report formatting requirements.","Fact-check external research details (e.g., verifying specifics of the Volkswagen case study) and audit calculations like defect percentages.","Carefully proofread all section headings and text to correct typographical errors such as 'DICUSSION'."],"criteria":{"C1":"You achieved an Excellent standard in your '#### INTRODUCTION' by clearly identifying multiple ethical issues within an engineering design context, articulating organizational pressures, and systematically naming all key stakeholders.","C2":"Your '### DICUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship' achieved Excellent by providing a balanced, objective analysis of the commercial and safety arguments for and against shipping, leading to sound decision-making recommendations across multiple stakeholder groups.","C3":"You demonstrated an Excellent ability to construct a compelling, logically ordered narrative. In '##### The Most Ethical Path', you effectively integrated organizational pressures and professional codes to justify your conclusion systematically.","C4":"You substantiated your work well using the NHS IT failure case study and professional codes. To reach Excellent, ensure complete factual accuracy in your case research (e.g., correcting the Volkswagen emissions details) and eliminate arithmetic errors when calculating defect rates.","C5":"Your writing was fluent and well-organized, placing this at Good. To reach Very Good or Excellent, you must include the required abstract, integrate visual elements (such as tables or figures) to support your discussion, and correct typos like 'DICUSSION'."}}
